skills.name: Oracle HCM
skills.description: FDD skill area: Oracle HCM. Criteria follow the approved four-level model and can be refined through catalogue amendments; these are application rubrics, not Oracle issuer criteria.

levels.name: Foundation

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Design Oracle HCM solutions, establish standards and mentor others using demonstrated experience.
